definitions.full: H1165. beir [ בְּעִיר ] noun masculine Exod 22:4 beasts, cattle , collective (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic id. , , Ethiopic etc., Sabean בער DHM ZMG 1876, 674; 1883, 329 ; Arabic of camel ; also ass , etc., compare Lane 227a ; connection with above √ obscure) — suffix בְּעִירֹה 22:4 , בְּעִירֵנוּ Num 20:4 , בְּעִירְכָם Gen 45:17 , כְּעִירָם Num 20:8 2 t.; — beasts of burden Gen 45:17 (i.e. asses 44:3 , 13 ); elsewhere General, cattle Exod 22:4 ; Num 20:4 , 8 , 11 ; Psa 78:48
